Mode change — Apply, then reboot the device to re-advertise the new identity.

SB20 handlebar buttons

Read the SB20's own shifter buttons and re-broadcast each press as the action you pick — an OpenBikeControl id (to a training app) or a local erg nudge. Applies live.

Calibrate against a reference

Reads your source (DUT) + a reference meter at once, then fits a correction curve so the source reads like the reference. Ride a spread of powers.

Calibration profile (portable)

The fitted correction curve. Export it to a file, then import it on your other device — the profile is portable across the nRF and ESP32 builds (and the desk tools).

Workout & erg (drive a trainer)

Connects to an FTMS trainer as a third link and holds the workout's target power (erg). Pick a trainer, load a preset, press Start.
